canonical.name: Where the Lanterns Went Out
canonical.summary: Inspect the fallen lantern on the north road and put three road revenants to rest. Return to Captain Rowan at the Thornford watch house.
canonical.offer: My patrol signed out at dusk. Their relief found men who had been buried for twenty years, carrying winter-work chits. Follow Lantern Road to the fallen cart. Read what is caught in the lantern, and put three revenants down before another traveller joins them. I would rather be wrong about all of this.
canonical.progress: The broken lantern is beside the cart on the north road. Three revenants, then bring me what you can read. Keep clear of the deeper graveyard for now.
canonical.complete: A stamped chit: ROOK & SONS — CONTINUANCE OF SERVICE. Rowan’s jaw tightens. “Their winter grain came with a labour clause. Apparently retirement was not the only thing it failed to mention.” The bell seal points to Old Watch. “End the Bellkeeper’s patrol. Fen’s woodland route is there if you want it; you need not clear the wolves for me.”

Rowan’s watch used to bring repair timber. Last night they stopped coming. One problem at a time. That is our entire emergency plan.

canonical.summary: Read the altered headstones at Nameless Yard and lay three gravewalkers to rest. Bring the evidence to Mayor Alder.
canonical.offer: I signed the winter relief. Three carts of grain, no child going hungry. Rook’s clerk called the rest “standard terms”. Now families vanish from the burial roll and appear on his work lists. Read the stones at Nameless Yard and lay three gravewalkers to rest. I need evidence, not someone to tell me I meant well.
canonical.progress: Take Mourning Road east of Old Watch. The yard lies south of Morrow’s apothecary. Copy the altered stones and put three gravewalkers down.
canonical.complete: Alder lays your copy beside the contract. “My mother’s family. Elsie’s father. Paid debts copied onto dead names.” He uncaps his ink. “My signature let the clerk in. Mine will go on the account of what happened. The keeper at Bell Crypt holds the original family seals. Until those return, the false roll keeps its hold.”

proposed_quests.title: The Heat Ledger
proposed_quests.personal_motivation: Enna is blamed for cold homes despite equal fuel shares; she wants a policy that accounts for insulation and vulnerability.
objective_sequence: Trace two fuel receipts and inspect heat loss and occupancy in three homes.
Allocate a fixed fuel budget on a board, then select one shared insulation repair with an explicit material cost.
Run a visual warmth test; revise until minimum shelter needs are met and ratify one of multiple workable policies.

reward.policy: Unbudgeted until regional XP and economy are calibrated for the level-50 model. Earlier low-level values are historical, not end-level payouts.

proposed_quests.aftermath: Only this district’s fuel board, one repaired wall and residents’ comments change. No continent economy or real-time winter wait.
proposed_quests.readiness: Future zone and new interaction mechanics required; not built
implementation_dependencies: New district, home access; heat/occupancy evidence; budget UI and evaluator; repair state; saved policy and readable costs.

implementation_dependencies: Knot interaction/evaluator; anchors and short traversal control; recorded teach-back; checkpoint and optional timer. No rope physics needed if using authored fixed traversal states.

proposed_quests.zone: Future volcanic frontier: Cinder Reach (working name)

reward.policy: Unbudgeted until regional XP and economy are calibrated for the level-50 model. Earlier low-level values are historical, not end-level payouts.

implementation_dependencies: Thermal cycle and visual cues; channel sequence state; crafting provenance event; checkpointed winch interaction; waves and rescue actor outcomes; no severe real-time fail timer. Mining 20 is a planned profession requirement, not a claim Smithing exists.

proposed_quests.title: Water Has a Name Here
proposed_quests.zone: Future desert oasis: Sable Well (working name)
proposed_quests.personal_motivation: Ruma wants honest rationing that keeps households, traveling drovers and market gardens viable after a leak is fixed.
objective_sequence: Measure three cistern draw points; interview the household, drover and garden delegates.
Locate and actually isolate a hidden leaking pipe; recompute the remaining genuine shortage.
Choose and fund a transparent feasible policy: rationing, shared transport or a short new channel; demonstrate one agreed allocation.

reward.policy: Unbudgeted until regional XP and economy are calibrated for the level-50 model. Earlier low-level values are historical, not end-level payouts.

proposed_quests.aftermath: One saved local service-cost/stock variant and three comments reflect the policy; every policy preserves basic water access.
proposed_quests.readiness: Future zone and new interaction mechanics required; not built
implementation_dependencies: Flow measurement and valve state; interview tracking; constraint/cost UI; repair validation; saved service variants. Existing shops require new conditional-price/stock support if that consequence is retained.

proposed_quests.title: Shade Is a Trade
proposed_quests.quest_type: Capped favor chain and carrying challenge
proposed_quests.personal_motivation: Sefi’s apprentice keeps working in the sun; she needs help coordinating supplies, not a hero to investigate a cult.
objective_sequence: Arrange a three-leg trade: cord to a potter, insulated jar to a dye seller, then dye to Sefi; each leg has one nearby recipient.
Carry a fresh dye batch along a short shaded route using a clearly displayed heat meter; replace it freely if it spoils.
Assist a real awning-fastening interaction, ending the chain at the apprentice’s stall.

reward.policy: Unbudgeted until regional XP and economy are calibrated for the level-50 model. Earlier low-level values are historical, not end-level payouts.

proposed_quests.aftermath: One awning state and apprentice work pose change; no additional hidden favors are appended.
proposed_quests.readiness: Future zone and new interaction mechanics required; not built
implementation_dependencies: Three recipient-linked deliveries can use existing quests; fragile batch/heat meter, free replacement and fastening action need new mechanics; shared total reward across legs.

proposed_quests.title: The Seamark at Low Water
proposed_quests.personal_motivation: Elva wants a shallow-water approach safe for small fishing boats while the merchants fund only the deep channel.
objective_sequence: Read three high/low-water marks around a short harbor loop; use a local tide model rather than wait for a real clock.
Align two seamark vanes to a visible shoreline bearing and test the route with a model float.
Secure one real mooring line at the chosen landing; show the pilot the corrected approach.

reward.policy: Unbudgeted until regional XP and economy are calibrated for the level-50 model. Earlier low-level values are historical, not end-level payouts.

proposed_quests.aftermath: Local seamarks and a small-boat landing scene persist; no new playable sailing system or time-of-day gate.
proposed_quests.readiness: Future zone and new interaction mechanics required; not built
implementation_dependencies: New harbor; controllable tide-model puzzle; alignment and route evaluation; mooring interaction; saved prop/landing state. Existing fishing water cannot supply these interactions.
